scope: FPGA compute counters only; no Host, PCIe, output verification or evidence-writing time

two_cohort_zero_host_layer_pipeline.formula: sum over layer pairs: A0 + max(A1, GU0) + GU1

limits: Attention compute excludes board-level metadata/RoPE/input/output DMA.
Compute counters include internal memory-supply waits and backpressure.
GU store and stall overlap compute; never add all four GU counters.
This bit lacks a shared compute timestamp/overlap counter; actual overlap union is not recoverable.
Each command processes one 16-row prefix of one request; each full 32-layer forward yields one new token.
The 16 rows cannot be counted as 16 independent new tokens.
Persistent KV incremental decode and multi-request row packing are not implemented by this fixed bit.
